what: When the heading enters the bottom 25% band of the screen, the letters light up in shuffled order (each letter .015s later, and the order reshuffles every time they open), floating up from 15% below with a .3s ease — as if a one-line serif heading sparkles into place here and there

options.each: Delay per step in the shuffled order (seconds), default .015
options.on: If ”state”, it turns on when the side not watching the screen adds is-in
options.--fx-dur: Duration of one letter floating up (via style), default .3s
options.line: Mixes separately for each direct child (line), adding line index × line seconds — botanist copy .2 (each letter .04–.05)
options.back: If on, hides when it exits below the screen again and reshuffles the order on the next entry (original removed and re-added -show)
options.--fx-y: Rising distance (via style), default 15% — reference site 100%
options.--fx-ease: Rise curve (via style), default ease — a sample site uses cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)
options.--fx-ease-o: Opacity curve (via style), default --fx-ease — Brand cubic-bezier(.445,.05,.55,.95)

from.where: Contact section title (.js-c-split-txt) — also the headings of sub-sections
